$comment: Founder rules that would get a Reddit account banned (groups 4-5 plan, 5.3). One list for the SQL triggers (migration 20270115040000, `~*`) and the zod at the routes (`apps/web/lib/cmo/sales/ban-risk.ts`, RegExp with the i flag). Patterns use only syntax both engines read the same way: no \b, no lookarounds. `ban-risk.check.ts` checks the SQL copy matches this file. A rule is refused when it matches a pattern and is about Sales: a memory with topic sales, or words in `scope`. `scope` names Reddit, HN and replies, not bare threads: an X thread is the Writer's. A clause that forbids the thing (`negated`: "never add links", "don't reply as the company account") is taken out before the patterns run, so the safe rule a founder writes is not refused; the SQL copy is in migration 20270116010000.

rules.message: Replies never carry a link: most communities remove them and ban the account. Write the rule without the link.
Replies come from you, a person, never as an official or company account. Write the rule without that.
Long or constant promotion gets an account banned. Replies help first and name the product at most once.
The same reply in many threads reads as spam and gets the account banned. Each reply is written for its thread.
